description: Render a document (PDF, SVG, or Office docx/xlsx/pptx) to one image per page. PDF needs the optional mupdf package; Office needs local LibreOffice. [LIMITED on this machine: SVG input works; PDF needs the optional `mupdf` package (npm i mupdf) and Office needs LibreOffice.]

dpi.description: Render resolution; higher is sharper and slower (default 144)

input.description: Path to the PDF, SVG or Office document

outDir.description: Directory to write page images into; created if absent

name: doc_to_images
